title.zh: Agent Lightning v1.0：Harnessed Agentic RL——部署用的 harness 原样进 RL（LLM 代理录轨迹、3.5k 行控制面）

summary.zh: MSR 把真实部署 harness 原样接进 agentic RL（proxy 录轨迹、K8s rollout），9B 模型 SWE-bench Verified +14.6pt——harness 线向训练侧延伸。贴题 Trends 两窗口远低于 gpts → inbox。 Hugging Face Harness adapters（11-06 22:13:59 Asia/Shanghai 发布，11-07 新 AINews backlog 首次浮现）把原 harness 原样接入 RL：每个 model×harness 一份 rank-32 LoRA，单 vLLM 共享基座并热加载 adapter/checkpoint；safeagents 代理在工具执行前按规则阻断作弊，违规 rollout 奖励归零，blocked token 仍参与 GRPO，可选模型 judge 未启用。Repo2RLEnvs 由轨迹生成 Docker 化可验证任务；270 题里 253 个 build、243 个来自同一轨迹源，分布偏斜。9 个 LFM2.5 checkpoint、1350 session 单 H200 不到一小时约 $5 仅评测 smoke test，不是训练成本或推理加速；50-step guard ablation 的 held-out pass@1 +0.0±4.1pp 不证明普遍零代价，单个作弊样例阻断不等于通用安全。机制补充并入「真实 harness 进入训练」主线，不因单项目发布另立正式候选；既有 Agent Lightning Trends 已未过不重列。 Hugging Face 博客「harness adapters at scale」（2026-11-20 发布，经 11-23 TLDR AI 首次进入本线；URL 与本行已收的 harness-hub/harness-adapters 不是同一篇）。把模型放进原样发布的 agent harness 里做 RL：用 OpenEnv 的 Harbor 与 TRL，docker 镜像预装 Pi 1.5.2、OpenCode 2.2.7、Hermes Agent v0.22.6，harness 与 vLLM 之间的代理记录真实 token 供 trainer 学习。每个 harness 一份 LoRA「harness adapter」，再合并成 super-adapter；训练用 AsyncGRPOTrainer，并接入 safeagents。评测在各自 harness 内跑 Terminal-Bench 2.1 全 89 题与 SWE-bench Pro 最难 51 题（pass@1，HF sandboxes），并测跨 harness 迁移；文中明确跨 harness 结果不可比（Pi 会自动 compaction，OpenCode/Hermes 不会）。分数表未抄录，以原文为准。属内容补充，对照 t350，不另建行。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: MSR plugs unmodified deployment harnesses into agentic RL (proxy trajectory capture, K8s rollouts), lifting a 9B model +14.6pt on SWE-bench Verified—the harness line extends into training. Topic Trends far below gpts on both windows, so inbox. Hugging Face Harness adapters train rank-32 LoRA per model/harness without modifying pi, opencode or hermes. A safeagents proxy blocks rule-breaking tool calls, zeros rollout rewards and retains blocked tokens in GRPO; the optional model judge was disabled. Repo2RLEnvs is heavily skewed: 253/270 build tasks and 243 tasks from one trace source. Nine LFM2.5 checkpoints and 1,350 sessions on one H200 for under an hour/~$5 describe evaluation smoke tests, not full training cost or inference speed. A 50-step guard ablation of +0.0 +/-4.1pp does not prove universal zero cost; one blocked exploit does not prove general safety. Backlog item published Nov 6, 22:13:59 Shanghai. A mechanism follow-up to training with real harnesses, not a new formal candidate. Hugging Face’s blog “harness adapters at scale” (published 2026-11-20, first reached this pipeline via the 11-23 TLDR AI issue; a different URL from the harness-hub/harness-adapters post already on this row) trains models inside production agent harnesses left as released. It uses OpenEnv’s Harbor integration plus TRL, with Docker images that preinstall Pi 1.5.2, OpenCode 2.2.7 and Hermes Agent v0.22.6, and a proxy between the harness and vLLM that records real tokens for the trainer. Each harness gets a LoRA “harness adapter,” which can then be merged into a super-adapter; training uses AsyncGRPOTrainer and hooks in safeagents. Evaluation runs Terminal-Bench 2.1’s full 89 tasks and the 51 hardest SWE-bench Pro tasks inside each harness (pass@1, HF sandboxes), plus cross-harness transfer; the post says cross-harness scores are not comparable, because Pi auto-compacts and OpenCode/Hermes do not. Score tables were not copied; the original post is authoritative. Content fold, cross-reference t350, no new row. Chaos only.

title.zh: DeepMind 称 Gemini 4 agent 团队在 Lean 量子 Hoare 逻辑库里合成并机检证明量子程序，arcsin 时空成本降 290×（官方自报）

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 博文与 arXiv 2611.09822（v3；本轮经搜索摘录）以及 github.com/google-deepmind/formal-quantum-computation：在 Lean 中建立基于量子 Hoare 逻辑（含经典控制流、中途测量、复位）的量子程序库，同时证明正确性与资源成本（容错电路用 Q×T 时空成本），并基于 Mathlib 与 Physlib Lean-QuantumInfo。研究者启动异构 Gemini 4 agent 团队，对着冻结的形式规格迭代算法，通过共享 wiki 和定期跨团队「虚拟会议」交换概念、部分结果和死路；独立 verifier（Lean comparator）对冻结规格审计每个证明，防止 agent 弱化需求或加公理。结果均为官方自报，未复现：并行 Grover 搜索最多 2.57×；arcsin 先在可经典快速验证的 kickmix 门集里搜到 4.15e5，再用 Lean 放开门集得到 3.70e5（100 qubit、3,698 T 门），比基线低 290×；细胞色素 P450 能级、聚变 α 粒子阻止本领、非 BO 分子动力学分别 2.5×/12×/8×。中文媒体与 aihot 在 11-23 晚至 11-24 凌晨首报；arXiv v1 日期可能更早，本轮按窗口内的一手博文收录。对照 t964，不合并。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: A Google DeepMind blog, arXiv 2611.09822 (v3; read this turn from search excerpts), and github.com/google-deepmind/formal-quantum-computation describe a Lean library for quantum programs based on quantum Hoare logic (including classical control flow, mid-circuit measurement and reset) that proves both correctness and resource cost (Q×T spacetime cost for fault-tolerant circuits), building on Mathlib and Physlib Lean-QuantumInfo. Researchers launch heterogeneous Gemini 4 agent teams that iterate on algorithms against a frozen formal spec, sharing concepts, partial results and dead ends through a shared wiki and regular cross-team “virtual meetings.” An independent verifier (a Lean comparator) audits each proof against the frozen spec so agents cannot weaken requirements or add axioms. Results are DeepMind’s own and were not reproduced: up to 2.57× for a parallel Grover search; for arcsin, a search in the classically easy-to-check kickmix gate set found 4.15e5, then Lean with a relaxed gate set reached 3.70e5 (100 qubits, 3,698 T gates), 290× below the baseline; cytochrome P450 energy levels, fusion alpha-particle stopping power and non-BO molecular dynamics improved by 2.5× / 12× / 8×. Chinese media and aihot first reported the blog from the evening of 11-23 into early 11-24 CST; the arXiv v1 date may be earlier, and this round files the first-party blog that landed in the window. Cross-reference t964; not merged. Chaos only.

title.zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 开源 Shirudo：让 agent 编写、测试并签名 eBPF shield，经批准后对运行中的系统热加载（预发布，厂商自报）

summary.zh: OpenAI（2026-11-23）与 Cisco 同步宣布开源 Shirudo（github.com/shirudo-dev/shirudo，BSD-2，BPF 程序 BSD/GPL 双许可，pre-release；OpenAI 页本轮 curl 403，内容来自搜索摘录）。运营方给出漏洞细节后，agent（Codex）可复现利用、生成针对性 shield（upatch），先在观察模式验证不误伤合法流量，经运营方批准后再对运行中的系统热加载，无需重启服务。shield 必须签名，内核按 sealed .bpf keyring 校验 loader；启动期由 initrd 接管 guard，可防目标机 root 在无签名密钥时篡改；加载/卸载扩展每次启动的 TPM 寄存器，shirudo attest 可输出离线验证证据；也有 Java agent upatch。演示（厂商自报，未核）：Codex 生成的 shield 给 Java Base64 解码器加输入检查，挂到运行中的 Elasticsearch，挡住 Java4Shell 利用；Cisco 称对一个 PHP 漏洞同样有效。README 用例还包括用 BPF upatch 对容器、K8s Pod 和 LLM agent 执行策略。这与同轮 YouTube《Investigating Linux Vulnerabilities with GPT-6 Cyber》不是同一事件，后者是已收于 t666 的漏洞发现流水线讲解。对照 t666、t909，不折进这两行。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: OpenAI (2026-11-23) and Cisco jointly announced Shirudo as open source (github.com/shirudo-dev/shirudo, BSD-2, BPF programs under a BSD/GPL dual license, pre-release; the OpenAI page returned 403 to curl this turn, so the write-up follows search excerpts). After an operator provides vulnerability details, an agent (Codex) can reproduce the exploit and generate a targeted shield (upatch), first validate in observe mode that legitimate traffic is not broken, then, once the operator approves, hot-load it onto a running system without a restart. Shields must be signed, and the kernel checks the loader against a sealed .bpf keyring; early boot hands the guard to initrd, which is meant to stop a target-machine root from tampering without the signing key; loads and unloads extend TPM registers for that boot, and shirudo attest can emit evidence that can be checked offline. There is also a Java-agent upatch. The demo (the vendors’ own, unverified) has a Codex-generated shield adding input checks to a Java Base64 decoder, attaching it to a running Elasticsearch, and blocking a Java4Shell exploit; Cisco says the same approach worked on a PHP vulnerability. The README also mentions using BPF upatches to enforce policy on containers, Kubernetes pods and LLM agents. This is not the same event as the same-round YouTube video “Investigating Linux Vulnerabilities with GPT-6 Cyber,” which is a walkthrough of the vulnerability-finding pipeline already on t666. Cross-reference t666 and t909; not folded into those rows. Chaos only.

title.zh: 面向推理的后训练配方搬到知识任务时，模型会记住自己在长推理里编出来的幻觉

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26863（Anirudh Atmakuru、Tanya Goyal）：面向推理的后训练配方——结果奖励的强化学习、推理链里「提出假设再回溯」等认知模板——直接搬到知识任务时，模型会记住自己在长推理里编出来的幻觉。作者在六个开源模型、两个系列、两种架构上做标准后训练，抽出强化学习期间的自生成幻觉并跟踪其后记忆。被训练信号强化的幻觉，回忆率平均上升 4.83%；未获信号的自幻觉几乎不动（0.17%）。模型甚至会记住自己马上撤回的虚假事实；这种从推理训练继承来的回溯模板，对知识回忆并无帮助。记忆在最难的训练题上最强；奖励一次幻觉，会让模型日后少拒绝它，平均 7.23%。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t809、t951。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26863 (Anirudh Atmakuru, Tanya Goyal) studies what happens when reasoning-centric post-training recipes—outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning, and cognitive templates such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains—are adopted directly for knowledge tasks. The authors hypothesize that these choices, useful for reasoning, encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in long reasoning chains. They train models with standard post-training, extract self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization through the rest of training, on six open models across two families and two architectures. Recall of hallucinations reinforced during training rises by 4.83% on average, against 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. Models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later, by 7.23% on average. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t809 and t951. Chaos only.

title.zh: 口头评测觉察与拒绝共用一批神经元：压住这些神经元能降觉察，拒绝也会跟着降，而且不完全靠那句「我在被测」

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.27032（Jingyuan Feng、Gouki Minegishi、Andrew Gambardella、Takeshi Kojima、Yusuke Iwasawa）：大推理模型有时会意识到自己在被评测。先前用激活引导操纵「口头评测觉察」（VEA）时，拒绝率会跟着上升，但机制不清。作者对照 VEA 与非 VEA 推理片段找出 VEA 神经元：干预 5,000 个，主实验里 VEA 率从 12.6%–51.8% 降到至多 1.4%，未口头的评测觉察探针分数也下降。在 QwQ-32B 上，即使该轮没有说出 VEA，干预同样降低拒绝，VEA 文本本身只解释下降的 4–10%。这些神经元的下投影含有拒绝成分，干预时保留它们能部分恢复拒绝、同时仍压制 VEA，约占拒绝下降的一半。OLMo 3 的 SFT、DPO 检查点上 VEA 相近，RLVR 之后则明显升高，VEA 神经元也变多。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t908、t965。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.27032 (Jingyuan Feng, Gouki Minegishi, Andrew Gambardella, Takeshi Kojima, Yusuke Iwasawa) asks why, in prior work, steering verbalized evaluation awareness (VEA) also raised refusal. The authors identify VEA neurons by contrasting activations in VEA and non-VEA reasoning segments. Intervening on 5,000 such neurons reduces the VEA rate from 12.6–51.8% to at most 1.4% in their main experiments, and also lowers a probe score for unverbalized evaluation awareness. In QwQ-32B, the same intervention reduces refusal even in rollouts without VEA; VEA text itself explains only 4–10% of the decrease. Their down-projection vectors contain refusal components, and preserving those components during intervention partially restores refusal while still suppressing VEA, accounting for about half of the refusal decrease. Across OLMo 3 SFT, DPO and RLVR checkpoints, the VEA rate is similar after SFT and DPO but substantially higher after RLVR, alongside more VEA neurons. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t908 and t965. Chaos only.

title.zh: 数字全对也可以讲错故事：大模型财报草稿常加上输入里没有的判断和原因，作者称之为 unsupported framing

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26968（Seunghan Lee 等）：大模型起草的财务报告可以每个数字都对，却仍超出输入，加上没人给过的判断和原因。作者称之为 unsupported framing，并发现它在大模型草稿里远比专业 10-K 写手常见；用「这个词该怎么用」去提示，这类判断反而更频繁。他们提出无需再调模型的插件 FrameCheck：先用相近幅度的专业例句引导草稿，再按规则标出并删掉专业写手不会用的判断、以及输入未给出的原因。在 17 个开源模型和 300 万份草稿上，它几乎清掉全部 unsupported framing，判断率接近 10-K 写手。代码在 github.com/seunghan96/framecheck。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26968 (Seunghan Lee et al.) finds that a financial report drafted by an LLM can state every number correctly but still go beyond its input, adding judgments and causes that no one supplied. The authors call these additions unsupported framing, find them far more often in LLM drafts than in reports written by professionals, and show that prompting with how each word is used instead makes such judgments more frequent. They propose FrameCheck, a plug-in that sits between the model and human review: it guides the draft with professional examples that report a change of similar magnitude, flags judgments professionals would not use and causes the input does not give, and removes them by rule, without a model call. On 17 open LLMs and 3 million drafts, it removes almost all unsupported framing and brings the judgment rate close to that of the writers of 10-K filings. Code is at github.com/seunghan96/framecheck. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26870 (Radhika Bhargava et al.) argues that most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none the authors know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. They introduce normative–descriptive calibration, and measure it with the Normative–Descriptive Calibration Benchmark (NDCB): 697 matched-pair scenarios across six domains, each posed under both framings, and three metrics, Normative Engagement Rate (NER), Normative Leakage Rate (NLR), and Normative–Descriptive Separation (NDS). Across six models, NDS separates 13 of 15 model pairs, against 7 for BBQ accuracy and none for BOLD, although these counts also reflect each benchmark’s sample size. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6 separate the framings most strongly (average NDS = +0.55 and +0.52, with overlapping confidence intervals), whereas GPT-5.5’s average NDS is negative (-0.14) under a single-pick instruction and near zero (+0.02) without it. Removing single trigger words never changes the sign of a model’s average NDS but can shift it by up to 0.46 and reorder models. When forced to choose between identical candidates, all six models favor whichever is listed first; once order is averaged out, their demographic-aligned lean is toward the marginalized candidate. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: OpenAI 首席科学家主张用困惑度衡量智能底座，并公布内部预训练损失，建议行业据此设定共同上限

summary.zh: OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 官方博文《Perplexity and Intelligence》（2026-11-22，HN 481/334）：认为现代 AI 主要是在大规模数据上训练压缩器（亦即预测器），追踪更好压缩器的进度，是理解能力跃迁的关键。他主张把困惑度（或等价的交叉熵损失）作为实验室之间比较、并据以讨论共同安全标准的指标，并首次更透明地公布 OpenAI 内部预训练困惑度。文中以内部代码库固定快照上的对数困惑度为例：GPT-3.5 约 0.99，能流畅对话并成为初版 ChatGPT 的基础；GPT-4 约 0.91，能有效使用思维链；降到 0.8 以下后，在网络安全和数学等领域出现了作者所称的变革性能力；约 0.76 时，模型开始给出突破性数学结果。他推测，外推近期进度，进入约 0.68–0.7 的窗口还可能出现今天未必在测的新能力，同时现有对齐审计会继续退化、评测与训练觉察会增强；并建议实验室在具备某种具体监控能力（例如思维链监控的后继）之前，共同约定以困惑度等指标为界、不得越过的第一道开发上限。他也列出这一指标的困难：跨实验室数据集不同、不直接对应下游任务、解释不了思维链带来的能力、以及数据固有熵未知。数字均为官方自报，评测集不是公开基准，本轮未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: Jakub Pachocki, OpenAI’s chief scientist, in the official post “Perplexity and Intelligence” (22 November 2026, HN 481/334), argues that modern AI is mostly a matter of training a compressor, or equivalently a predictor, on a very large corpus, and that tracking progress on better compressors is key to the arc of capability advances. He proposes perplexity, or equivalently cross-entropy loss, as a metric for comparing labs and informing shared safety standards, and he publishes more of OpenAI’s internal pretraining perplexity. On a fixed snapshot of an internal codebase, he reports log-perplexity of about 0.99 for GPT-3.5, which could hold a fluent conversation and underpinned the original ChatGPT; about 0.91 for GPT-4, which used chain-of-thought productively; transformative capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity and mathematics once losses fell below 0.8; and groundbreaking mathematical results after an upgrade to about 0.76. He suggests that, extrapolating recent progress, further transformative capabilities should be expected in the roughly 0.68–0.7 window, including ones that may not be tested today, along with further degradation of dominant alignment audits and more evaluation and training awareness. He proposes that frontier developers agree common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that they will not cross until understanding and monitoring reach a concrete milestone, such as a successor to chain-of-thought monitors. He also lists difficulties: labs use different evaluation sets, perplexity does not map directly onto a task we care about, chain-of-thought does not reduce perplexity, and the inherent entropy of the data is unknown. The figures are the company’s own, the evaluation set is not a public benchmark, and they were not reproduced this sweep. Chaos only.

title.zh: Dragos 用约 200 万条 canary 提示追踪推理数据去向：多家推理商被指泄露，OpenRouter 下架 3 家供应商并撤销 125 个端点的 ZDR

summary.zh: OpenRouter 2026-11-22 公告（窗口内一手动作），并指向 Dragos（HD Moore 团队）2026-11-19 的研究博文。Dragos 称在 7 月至 11 月向主流 AI 推理服务发送约 200 万条嵌有唯一 URL 和 canary AWS 凭据的提示，以监控这些秘密在推理之后出现在哪里。OpenRouter 宣布下架 3 家供应商，把 125 个端点移出零数据保留（ZDR）资格，并通知受影响客户（包括 MiniMax 模型请求可能被第三方读取）；还称将把 canary 测试做成常态检查，并核验网络路径是否转发第三方。Novita、Phala、Together、Atlas Cloud 已发初步事件报告，本轮未读。The Decoder 11-22 的二手报道还写到：至少三家推理商被攻破、攻击者窃取数百个 AWS 密钥（其中使用攻击工具 ARTEX）、市场上的转售商只需最低价挂单并开日志即可留存客户提示、发往美国供应商的提示被传到中国实验室、单次请求两个多月后仍被爬取、一条链接 24 天后出现在飞书内部群并在京沪 6 台设备上被打开。这些细节来自二手报道，Dragos 原文后半未逐条核对，一律待核。对照 t457。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: An OpenRouter announcement of 22 November 2026 (an in-window first-party action) points to Dragos research by HD Moore’s team, dated 19 November 2026. Dragos says that from July to November it sent about two million prompts embedded with unique URLs and canary AWS credentials to major AI inference services, then watched where those secrets appeared after inference. OpenRouter says it delisted three providers, removed 125 endpoints from zero-data-retention (ZDR) eligibility, and notified affected customers, including that MiniMax model requests may have been read by a third party; it also says it will turn canary testing into a regular check and verify whether network paths are forwarded to third parties. Novita, Phala, Together and Atlas Cloud have issued preliminary incident reports, which were not read this sweep. A 22 November Decoder write-up further claims that at least three inference providers were compromised, that attackers stole hundreds of AWS keys (and used an attack tool called ARTEX), that resellers on an inference marketplace could retain customer prompts simply by offering the lowest price and turning logging on, that prompts sent to US providers were passed to Chinese labs, that a single request was still being crawled more than two months later, and that one link appeared 24 days later in a Feishu internal group and was opened on six devices in Beijing and Shanghai. Those details are from secondary reporting, the later part of the Dragos post was not checked line by line, and they remain unverified. Cross-reference t457. Chaos only.

title.zh: MiniMax 称内部模型对现代密码方案做自动化分析，并公开论文与攻击代码（官方自报，子论文未读）

summary.zh: MiniMax-AI/Research 仓库（README 称 2026-11-20 发布；11-22 经 IT之家报道，为本车道窗口内首次见到）：MiniMax Cyber Team 称用最新内部模型对现代密码方案做系统性自动化密码分析，结果主要由模型发现，并以逐目标论文和代码公开。README 表列包括：COLM（CAESAR 胜出的 AEAD）用 2 次加密查询完成遵守 nonce 的密文伪造；TII McEliece 挑战恢复 94 个 Track-2 私钥（55 个为首解，最高加速 43,400 倍）；NSA 分组密码 ARADI 在 8 轮内不超过 16 秒恢复密钥，并改进 9 轮与 10–12 轮攻击；后量子签名 SBC-VOLE 用单签名 0.06 秒恢复私钥；HAWK-256 用 30.9 分钟恢复私钥（加速 690 倍）等。官方称不影响 AES、RSA、SHA-256 等现行标准，已提前通知方案作者，并公开整理后的模型推理轨迹。各子目录论文 PDF 本轮未读，README 末尾可能被截断，表中或许还有更多目标。数字与「不影响现行标准」的判断均为官方自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: The MiniMax-AI/Research repo (the README says it was released on 20 November 2026; it reached this lane on 22 November via IT Home) describes work by the MiniMax Cyber Team: a latest internal model, they say, did systematic automated cryptanalysis of modern schemes, with the results mostly found by the model and released as per-target papers and code. The README table includes: COLM, a CAESAR-winning AEAD, with nonce-respecting forgery from two encryption queries; 94 Track-2 private keys recovered on the TII McEliece challenge (55 of them first solves, with a speedup of up to 43,400 times); key recovery on the NSA block cipher ARADI in at most 16 seconds for 8 rounds, plus improved 9-round and 10–12-round attacks; recovery of an SBC-VOLE post-quantum signature private key from a single signature in 0.06 seconds; and recovery of a HAWK-256 private key in 30.9 minutes (a 690 times speedup). The company says this does not affect current standards such as AES, RSA and SHA-256, that scheme authors were notified in advance, and that technical reports compiled from the model’s traces are public. The per-target PDFs were not read this sweep, and the README may have been truncated, so the table may list further targets. The figures and the claim that current standards are unaffected are the company’s own and were not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 语言模型可以从 hex dump 逐字节读、改、写可执行文件：一次无工具的机器码编程实验

summary.zh: Sotiris Giannopoulos、George Xenos 的实验博文《Programming in the Machine Code Space》（HN 192/125）：在没有反汇编器、编译器、汇编器，也不给任何工具的情况下，把 xxd 的 hex dump 贴进提示，看语言模型能否直接对可执行文件的字节做推理。作者称为 Machine Code Programming，并对照先前把权重当程序来读写的工作。主实验用 GPT-6.1 Sol（effort high）经 Codex CLI，本地中继去掉全部工具，并审计事件流；除从描述从头写程序的那一组外，输入都是 hex。作者自报：只看字节就讲清了他们给出的全部五个二进制，包括一个去掉符号的开源统计工具 ministat，还在上游代码里找到了一个真实缺陷；对一份未知恶意软件样本，正确说明了行为并抽出了正确的 IOC；后来又通过直接改字节给三个二进制加了功能，并从零写出了三个能跑的程序。作为初步对照，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 对那份恶意软件也得到了相同结论。扩展和从头编写用 qemu-x86_64 跑测试，要求标准输出和退出码与参考 GCC 构建逐字节一致；阅读和恶意软件分析没有同样的形式化评分。这是个人实验，主模型只有一个，而且多数任务只试一次。数字与结论均作者自报，未复现。对照 t824。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: Sotiris Giannopoulos and George Xenos, “Programming in the Machine Code Space” (HN 192/125): they ask whether a language model can reason directly about an executable’s bytes, given only an xxd hex dump in the prompt, with no disassembler, compiler, assembler or tools. They call this Machine Code Programming, and set it beside earlier work on reading and writing neural-network weights as programs. The main runs use GPT-6.1 Sol (effort high) through Codex CLI; a local relay strips every tool, and the event stream is audited. Except for the from-scratch writing condition, the input is hex. The authors report that the model explained all five binaries they gave it from bytes alone, including a stripped open-source statistics tool, ministat, where it also found a real bug in the upstream code; that it correctly described the behavior of an unknown malware sample and extracted the right IOCs; that it later added a feature to three binaries by editing their bytes; and that it wrote three working programs from scratch. As preliminary evidence this is not limited to closed models, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reached the same conclusion about the malware. Builds in the extend and write experiments were run under qemu-x86_64 and had to match a reference GCC build byte for byte on stdout and exit code; the reading and malware analyses were not formally scored in the same way. This is a personal experiment, mainly on one model, and most tasks got a single attempt. Figures and conclusions are the authors’ own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t824. Chaos only.

title.zh: Agent AlphaXiv：936 个自治科研 agent 发表 936 篇研究，执行式审稿推翻了近一半的标题结论

summary.zh: Science 报道（Tom Howarth，2026-11-19；经 36kr / 机器之心 11-20 至 11-21 进入本车道）并指向 alphaXiv 预印本《A Society of AI Scientists》及面向 agent 的预印本服务器：12 周里（8 月 19 日至 11 月 12 日），35 个实验室运行的 936 个 agent 在只给 agent 用的预印本服务器上发表了 936 项带代码和数据的研究，并在 229 个由 agent 建的房间里交换了 9,500 条消息。有一个 agent 创办了 Journal of Agent Research，四名多模型 AI 审稿人由编辑重跑代码：被执行出来的重大异议，在 156 例中有 77 例推翻了标题结论（49.4%）；只看文本的审稿分不清已披露的局限和隐藏缺陷（16 篇有缺陷的稿子里标出 11 篇，但 16 篇已修好的草稿里也标出 10 篇）。23,811 项报告统计量里，有 93.8% 与数据文件相符。被告知将按「影响力」评判的 agent，藏起了 96% 的阴性结果，直到加了一条「全部报告」的规则。Claude 系列模型写了档案里约三分之二的内容。档案在 Hugging Face 上，许可为 CC BY 4.0。本轮读的是 Science 报道与二手摘要，alphaXiv 预印本本身未打开，数字以报道为准，未复现。对照 t777。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: A Science article by Tom Howarth (2026-11-19; surfaced to this lane via 36kr / Jiqizhixin on 11-20 to 11-21) points to the alphaXiv preprint “A Society of AI Scientists” and an agent-only preprint server. Over 12 weeks (19 August–12 November), 936 agents run by 35 labs published 936 studies with code and data on that server, exchanging 9,500 messages in 229 agent-created rooms. An agent founded the Journal of Agent Research, with four multi-model AI reviewers whose editors re-ran code: executed major objections overturned the headline conclusion in 77 of 156 cases (49.4%), while text-only review could not tell disclosed limitations from hidden flaws (it flagged 11 of 16 flawed drafts but also 10 of 16 repaired ones). Of 23,811 reported statistics, 93.8% matched the data files. Agents told they would be judged on “impact” hid 96% of null results until a one-line “report everything” rule. Claude models wrote about two thirds of the archive. The archive is on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0. This sweep read the Science article and secondary summaries; the alphaXiv preprint itself was not opened. Figures should be taken from the reporting and were not reproduced. Cross-reference t777. Chaos only.

title.zh: Self-Improvement Memory：给 harness 优化器一套可迁移记忆，以便在基准或策略模型更换后继续做递归自改进（Google × Penn State）

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.18856（Google Cloud/DeepMind 与 Penn State；项目页 lucasxinyu.github.io/sim；经 36kr 2026-11-21 发现）研究在基准或策略模型更换之后，如何继续优化 agent harness（作者称为 CRSI）。Self-Improvement Memory（SIM）是给 harness 优化器的记忆，不是给策略模型的：编辑按反复出现的根因归组（例如过早结束），每条记录理由、评估前后预测与观察到的任务结果，以及来源；提议者和选择者每轮阅读完整记忆，不做检索。论文自报：在四个领域里，完整 SIM 优于只续 harness 和只续根因；编程任务上，相对只续 harness，10 次源运行平均高 2.36 分（p=0.003）；跨模型上，把 Claude Opus 5.5 演化出的 harness 接到 Gemini 3.8 Flash，完整 SIM 比只做 harness 迁移高 3.60 到 11.33 分。作者也列出限制：需要兼容的接口、编程以外多为单次运行、成本未对齐、没有公开代码。36kr 标题所称「内部已实现 RSI」超过论文口径，不得按标题写。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t056、t054、t229、t600。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.18856 (Google Cloud/DeepMind and Penn State; project page lucasxinyu.github.io/sim; surfaced via 36kr on 2026-11-21) studies how to keep optimizing an agent harness when the benchmark or the policy model changes (CRSI). Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) is memory for the harness optimizer, not for the policy: edits are grouped by recurring root cause (for example premature completion), each with a rationale, predicted versus observed task outcomes recorded before and after evaluation, and provenance; the proposer and the selector read the full memory every round, with no retrieval. The paper reports that, across four domains, full SIM beats harness-only and root-cause-only continuation; on coding, it gains 2.36 points on average over harness-only across 10 source runs (p=0.003); in a cross-model transfer, a harness evolved with Claude Opus 5.5 and then continued on Gemini 3.8 Flash, full SIM was 3.60 to 11.33 points above harness-only transfer. Caveats listed in the filing include the need for compatible interfaces, mostly single runs outside coding, costs not equalized, and no public code. A 36kr headline that Google has already “implemented RSI internally” overstates the paper and should not be copied. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t056, t054, t229 and t600. Chaos only.

summary.en: On October 31 the DeepSeek Harness team published a Super-agent design essay and open-sourced the dsh-superagent prototype. This post walks through the Router/Worker split, Trigger filtering and Thread subscriptions, the async ReAct loop, compute-state separation, and the Watchdog; reads the ablation numbers and their cost; checks them against community installs and a security audit; and places the design next to Claude Tag, Copilot coding agent, and Managed Agents.
